title: 3.2 Single Rotations (LL / RR)
objective: For each puzzle, click the unbalanced pivot node (|BF| > 1), then choose [LL: Rotate Right] or [RR: Rotate Left] to repair it!
controls: Step 1: Click unbalanced pivot node -> Step 2: Click [LL (1/L)] or [RR (2/R)]
start_status: Puzzle 1/2: Click the unbalanced pivot node (|BF| > 1) on the AVL tree, then pick [LL] or [RR]!
hints: Find the node whose |BF| is 2: if its left subtree is taller (BF = +2), use LL (Rotate Right); if its right subtree is taller (BF = -2), use RR (Rotate Left).
Now the subtree leans right (BF = -2 at the pivot): select the pivot and pick RR (Rotate Left).
